title: CM17 worker RefCell borrow panic in Spot Struggle peer scan
status: Intermittent crash reported; user replayed all 11 arms (44,000 races) without recurrence. Cause and crashed binary source identity remain unconfirmed.

buildIdentification.head: efc2decdfeaff227ada0e9847f5deceb42c3b97f
buildIdentification.note: Line 2606 happens to match a peer read in HEAD and the archived v74 source. The crashed binary is not tied to either snapshot, so this is a candidate mapping only.
buildIdentification.userClarification: The crashed binary was built before the uncommitted GlobalSim working-tree changes.

codeLocation.context: Read strategy, position, lane and started state of peers while selecting the lead-competition group.
codeLocation.mappingStatus: Candidate source location, not established crash attribution.

findings: An immutable RefCell borrow fails here if that peer already has an outstanding mutable borrow.
The loop reads self directly for j == field_index and borrows other runner cells.
RaceField::new assigns runner indices; inspected production stepping loops scope each runner borrow to its individual update.
No concrete borrow-lifetime defect was identified in the inspected path.
Skipping a failed peer borrow would change the competition participant scan and is not a justified correction.

validation.scope: The eight local tests cover the current checkout. Separately, the user reports 44,000 exact-block replays with no crash. Neither establishes the original borrow holder or original binary source.

userReplay.inputs: User rebuilt the exact block inputs with the same seeds and lobbies.
userReplay.evidenceSource: User report; not independently rerun here.

processDependentState.assessment: The reported replay outcome supports investigating state beyond individual race seeds and lobbies; it does not identify the specific mechanism.

hashMapIteration.status: No supporting path found in inspected current or archived v74 source
hashMapIteration.assessment: The HashMaps found in src are parser-cache lookup tables. They use keyed lookup/insertion and whole-cache clearing, not iteration to choose runners or activation order. Their keys include a static table address, used only as cache identity. This review cannot rule out differences in the unidentified crashed build.

spotStrugglePeerMutation.assessment: The participant list is collected before mutation. The owner is handled via self, and each peer borrow is scoped to start_spot_struggle. That method updates local state/modifiers and does not call back into field scanning.

duelPeerMutation.assessment: Peer reads during selection and history checks end before the mutable peer borrow. Activation updates local state/modifiers and does not invoke callbacks or recurse into peer scanning. No overlapping borrow established in the inspected path.

nextOccurrenceEvidence: Capture exact binary SHA256 and matching source revision/snapshot.
Capture full panic backtrace and worker command/API mode.
Capture failed request plus preceding requests in that worker and batch/arm identifiers, since process history may matter.
